description.value: A rustic non-profit campground on Squamish's edge near the Mamquam River, serving climbers, cyclists, and paddlers at very affordable rates; no water on site (bring your own — potable water is 600 m away), outhouses only, and strong afternoon winds make it a genuine hazard for tents.

address.value: 2023 Centennial Way, Squamish, British Columbia V8B 0A9, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mamquamrivercampground.ca is fully functional and detailed. Key amenity facts confirmed from website text: no water or electricity on-site (stated repeatedly and explicitly), free phone charging stations in lockers by the firewood bin, 46 walk-in sites with cyclists listed as a primary guest group, and online reservations required via checkfront.com. Address (2023 Centennial Way, Squamish, BC V8B 0A9) and phone (604-848-9841) both appear on the website contact page, corroborating OSM values.
concerns: OSM address field is empty; address sourced from website contact page (2023 Centennial Way, Squamish, BC V8B 0A9) — contact_confirmed.address set to null as there is no OSM value to corroborate.
Website displays 'filler@godaddy.com' in the navigation sign-in widget — this is a GoDaddy site-builder template artifact and not an operational business email.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established non-profit campground in Squamish that explicitly serves cyclists with affordable walk-in sites, free device charging, and direct municipal trail access — a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: No electricity or water on-site; touring cyclists should arrive self-sufficient with water. Nearest potable water is 600m away at Brennan Park Community Center (Loggers Lane and Centennial). Campground is non-profit; surplus revenue is reinvested into facilities.
